title: Korean-Style Samphire Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir-fry dish made with samphire, inspired by Korean cuisine. Perfect as a side or main course.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef substitute (if using) and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the samphire, guk, and chili flakes to the skillet. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the samphire starts to soften.
Add the soy sauce and rice vinegar (if using) to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Return the beef substitute (if using) to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the samphire is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
